top.line: Mapping an Agent Behaviour Policy onto Manus: wide reach, real controls, and a record of the gap between them.
top.para: Manus works in a cloud computer, on your computer, in your browser with your logins, across 416 connectors and in unattended automations. Its documentation describes real controls and says what they leave open. An Agent Behaviour Policy records reach, mandate, gap and the control that holds each row, and can live in four places: read, set, gate and attest. The first two exist in Manus; the last two are proposals. Nothing has been run on Manus yet.

in-short.line: Wide reach, real controls, the policy as the missing record, four places it lives, nothing tested yet.
in-short.para: Six points from Manus's documentation, read on 9 November 2026.

why.line: Manus is on Web Summit's opening night, independent again after China blocked Meta's purchase.
why.para: Meta's roughly $2 billion deal was blocked on 27 April 2026; Manus raised more than $500 million in October. For RiskMandate it is the agent with the most reach a business can switch on in an afternoon.

reach.line: A cloud sandbox, your computer, your browser and logins, 416 connectors, automations, email, Projects and Skills.
reach.para: Each item is a row in an Agent Behaviour Policy.

controls.line: Permission modes, session approval, approved senders, conditions; and a candid statement of the gaps.
controls.para: Approval modes limit changes, not reading; planning happens in the Manus cloud. The controls are barriers, the candid sentences are gaps.

example.line: An invented morning prospecting task, as reach, mandate, gap and barrier.
example.para: Send email, everything a LinkedIn session can do, edit and delete deals, running unattended and instructions inside forwarded email: each with a setting, an instruction, or open.

layers.line: Read, set, gate, attest: a Project instruction or Skill, Manus settings, a custom MCP gate, evidence and sign-off.
layers.para: Read and set exist today; a gate for internal systems and attestation from Manus's logs are proposals.

offer.line: Templates per Manus surface, the policy as a Skill, the five-minute try in Manus, and a policy per Project.
offer.para: The Skill and the try are proposed and untested.

limits.line: Not run on Manus; the deployment is invented; gate and attest are proposals.
limits.para: No judgement of Manus's safety, and no relationship with Manus.

sources.line: Manus's documentation pages, three news reports, riskmandate.ai and earlier newsroom articles.
